reason: 该插件主要面向用户在 DSH Web 界面内提供一个可见可互动的桌面宠物伴侣体验，并通过其技能清单向会话引入多个人格与攻略类能力，因此应归类为桌面/界面型用户体验插件；现有证据显示其功能以本地界面交互与会话状态联动为主，无明确外部服务调用。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH Web GUI 提供可互动的 Pingo 浮动桌宠，并附带多种 Persona 与攻略类技能供会话使用。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an interactive Pingo companion to the DSH web GUI and exposes multiple persona and strategy-related skills for session use.

capabilities: Displays an interactive floating desktop-pet avatar in the DSH Web GUI with animation/state reactions
Provides user actions for the pet such as drag, feed, and play interactions
Registers multiple DSH skills (persona variants and strategy/support skills) for agent session use
Persists plugin state/XP/memory data in local client/server-side files for continuity

reasons.code: Package manifest defines an official DSH bundle with web client and multiple skill entries
README documents floating pet behavior, animations, interaction actions, and game mini-features
README notes persistent state and memory storage under DSH data location and localStorage config
Repository structure includes client code and skill directories consistent with bundle-plugin delivery
